messages:
alex.chen: Hey support — adding an iOS Shortcut that calls Redwood API started returning 401 invalid_api_key. Desktop works fine. Any ideas?

sam: Can you paste the exact header/curl youre sending and a trace id if possible? Also which key type (hosted/dedicated/private)?

alex.chen: curl -i -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/generate
  -H "Authorization: Bearer \"rk_live_ABC123def456\""
  -H "Content-Type: application/json"
  -d '{"prompt":"hi"}'
HTTP/1.1 401 Unauthorized
{"error":"invalid_api_key","message":"401 unauthorized"}
X-Request-ID: trace_789

alex.chen: Using a hosted key (created in dashboard). I copied it from Notes to my Shortcut text action.

morgan: Looks like the Authorization header in your curl has extra quotes around the key: Authorization: Bearer \"rk_live_...\" — iOS Shortcuts "Text" or some clipboard actions sometimes wrap values in quotes. That becomes part of the key and will 401.

sam: Also watch for trailing newlines or invisible chars. Our auth system treats the exact bytes as the key. Quick check on mac/linux:

printf '%s' "YOUR_KEY" | xxd -g 1
# trailing 0a or 0d bytes will show up

morgan: Fix options in Shortcuts: replace the Text action with "Get Clipboard" (not JSON/Text), or add a "Replace Text" action to remove leading/trailing \" characters and newlines. Example header should be:

Authorization: Bearer rk_live_ABC123def456

alex.chen: ran the xxd check — output shows: 72 6b 5f 6c 69 76 65 5f 41 42 43 31 32 33 0d 0a => yep 0d 0a at end and the key is wrapped in quotes when I use a Text action.

morgan: Cool — in Shortcuts add a Replace step: replace \"\" with nothing, and replace \n/newline/ with nothing (there's a special newline token). Or pipe through a trim step in your script.

alex.chen: Did that, re-run the Shortcut and now request returns 200. Thanks! :tada:

deploy-bot: note saved -> support/known-issues: mobile-shortcuts-clipboard-quotes (owner: morgan)

sam: Glad its resolved. We'll add a short KB entry about mobile clipboard quoting/trailing-newline causing 401s. If you hit it again, paste the raw header bytes and the x-request-id.

alex.chen: thanks everyone :raised_hands:
